options.content:
### PO staleness gate — Task #32 Phase-3 bake watch
Watch this board WHILE the gate bakes, BEFORE flipping the `PO_STALENESS` flag. Two signals mean **different** things:

- **409 rejections (the alarm, red panels)** — the gate REJECTED a write (`STALE_HEAD` / `RANGE_CONFLICT` / `BEYOND_HORIZON`), surfaced as an HTTP 409 on `/api/production-orders/*`. This **must stay ~0**. A sustained non-zero = the gate is rejecting legitimate writes → alert `POStalenessGateRejectingWrites` fires (10m).
- **`po_gate_degraded_total{reason}` (informational, NOT an alarm)** — the gate degraded-to-**ALLOW** on open-segment drift (`running_no_open` / `wrong_row` / `orphan_open`). A degrade is a fail-safe ALLOW, not a rejection. Expect low/flat, trending to 0 as the #34 zombie-backfill cleanup lands.

Datasource pinned to `packiot-prometheus` on every target (unpinned = the dead-tile → Postgres fallback bug).

panels.title: 409 rejection rate (req/s) — MUST be ~0
panels.description: sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{route=~"/api/production-orders/.*", status="409"}[5m])). The alarm headline: any sustained non-zero means the gate is rejecting writes. Backed by alert POStalenessGateRejectingWrites.

panels.title: Degrade-to-ALLOW rate (req/s) — informational
panels.description: 🟡 TRUTHFUL-EMPTY today, not yet a live signal: po_gate_degraded_total has zero Go call sites in services/+edge-api as of 2026-08-20 (verified: 0 live Prometheus series) — ADR-0023 lists the degrade-to-ALLOW gate as '0 — Foundation (in flight)'. The `or vector(0)` fallback makes this read as a healthy 0 either way, so this will keep reading correctly once the metric ships — nothing to fix here, just don't mistake today's 0 for 'gate proven healthy'. sum(rate(po_gate_degraded_total[5m])). A degrade is an ALLOW (fail-safe), NOT a rejection. Low/flat, trending to 0 as #34 backfill cleans data. Blue = informational, not an alarm.

panels.title: PO-route traffic (req/s) — gate liveness
panels.description: sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{route=~"/api/production-orders/.*"}[5m])). Sanity: if this is 0 the gate is seeing NO PO traffic — the 409=0 above is then 'no data', not 'healthy'. Confirm the gate is actually exercised.

panels.title: THE ALARM — PO-route 409 rate by route (must hold 0)
panels.description: sum by (route) rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{route=~"/api/production-orders/.*", status="409"}[5m]). Every non-zero series names the route whose writes the gate is rejecting. Red threshold band; alert POStalenessGateRejectingWrites fires on sustained > 0 for 10m.

panels.title: Degrade-to-ALLOW rate by reason (informational)
panels.description: 🟡 TRUTHFUL-EMPTY today (renders as 'No data', no `vector(0)` fallback on this one): po_gate_degraded_total is unimplemented (see panel 3's note) — this panel will show 'No data' until the metric ships, which is expected, not a broken query. sum by (reason) rate(po_gate_degraded_total[5m]). reasons: running_no_open / wrong_row / orphan_open. These are ALLOWs on open-segment drift, not rejections — expected low/flat and trending to 0 as #34 backfill cleans zombie open segments. NOT alerted.

panels.title: PO-route request rate by route × status (gate liveness)
panels.description: sum by (route, status) rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{route=~"/api/production-orders/.*"}[5m]). Confirms the gate is seeing PO traffic and shows the status mix; 409 series are forced red.

panels.title: PO-route p95 latency by route (gate's extra DAO reads shouldn't regress this)
panels.description: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (route, le) rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"/api/production-orders/.*"}[5m])). The gate adds DAO reads (HEAD lookup, open-segment check) on the PO write path — watch p95 stay flat across the bake.
